000015.task: Go to the Contact Us page. In the contact form, fill the Name and Message fields but leave Email empty (or whitespace only), then submit.
000015.expected_result: An inline error message appears, no success/confirmation state is shown, and the values already typed in Name and Message remain in the fields.

000015.task: On the same contact form, fill Name, a valid Email containing '@' and '.', and Message, then submit.
000015.expected_result: An in-page confirmation appears on the Contact Us page without navigating away, containing the word 'Received' or 'Submitted' and including the submitted name or email.

000016.task: Go to the Contact page. In the contact form, enter a Name and Message but type an invalid email without '@' or '.' (e.g. 'testmail'), then submit.
000016.expected_result: A clear inline error appears for the email field, no confirmation banner is shown, and the typed Name, Email, and Message values remain in the inputs.

000016.task: Correct the email to a valid address containing '@' and '.', then submit the form.
000016.expected_result: An in-page confirmation banner appears on the Contact page without navigating away, containing 'Received' or 'Submitted' together with the submitted name or email.

000019.task: Go to the Contact page. Submit the contact form with the 'How can we help?' field empty while Name and Email are filled.
000019.expected_result: An inline error message appears, no confirmation is shown, and all values typed so far (including Company if entered) are preserved in the form.

000019.task: Fill Name, a valid Email containing '@' and '.', and the 'How can we help?' field, then submit.
000019.expected_result: An in-page confirmation appears on the Contact page without navigating away, including 'Received' or 'Submitted' plus the submitted name or email.

000064.task: Go to the Newsletter page. Enter an invalid email without '@' or '.' (e.g. 'newsfan') into the subscription input and click Subscribe.
000064.expected_result: A clear inline error message appears, no success state is shown, and the typed value remains in the input.

000064.task: Replace it with a valid email containing '@' and '.', then click Subscribe.
000064.expected_result: An in-page confirmation appears on the same page without navigating away, containing 'Received' or 'Submitted' along with the submitted email address.

000071.task: Go to the Contact page's 'Get in Touch' form. Submit it with the Message field empty (or spaces only) while Name and Email are filled.
000071.expected_result: A clear inline error message appears, no saved/confirmation line is shown, and the typed Name and Email values are preserved in the form.

000071.task: Fill all three fields with valid values (email containing '@' and '.') and submit.
000071.expected_result: An in-page confirmation appears beneath the form without navigating away, including 'Received' or 'Submitted' together with the submitted name or email.

000075.task: Scroll to the Contact Us section. Submit the contact form with all fields empty.
000075.expected_result: A clear inline error message appears within the Contact Us section, no success state is shown.

000075.task: Fill name, a valid email containing '@' and '.', and a message, then submit.
